training_examples.sentence: The Cox proportional hazards model was applied to the data in order to determine the prognostic factors for long - term survival .

Multivariate Cox survival analysis identified baseline EF < or = 30 % , presence of significant mitral regurgitation ( > 2 + ) before ablation , and failure to exhibit improved cardiac performance by 1 month after ablation as the only independent predictors of death .

No dominant clinical factor of risk was found , but multiple regression analysis identified age , body surface area , valve size , shop order fracture rate , and manufacturing period as risk factors for OSF .
In the long term , questions still remain about whether pre - dialysis rHu EPO either speeds up or delays the onset of dialysis .

training_examples.sentence: We present evidence that the upstream open reading frame ( uORF ) represses the translation of the downstream major open reading frame ( mORF ) .
The MPS1 open reading frame has been fused to those that encode the LexA protein or the GST protein and both of these constructs function in yeast .

They include genes encoding three subunits of the cytochrome oxidase ( cox1 to 3 ) , apocytochrome b ( cob ) , seven subunits of the NADH dehydrogenase complex ( nad1 to 6 , nad4L ) , two ATPase subunits ( atp6 and atp9 ) , three ribosomal RNAs ( rrn5 , srn and lrn ) , 23 tRNAs and four ribosomal proteins ( rps3 , rps11 , rps12 and rpl16 ) .
The most striking difference in the birch NAD ( P ) H - NR sequence in comparison to NADH - NR sequences was found at the putative pyridine nucleotide binding site .

training_examples.sentence: We present evidence that the upstream open reading frame ( uORF ) represses the translation of the downstream major open reading frame ( mORF ) .
The MPS1 open reading frame has been fused to those that encode the LexA protein or the GST protein and both of these constructs function in yeast .

They include genes encoding three subunits of the cytochrome oxidase ( cox1 to 3 ) , apocytochrome b ( cob ) , seven subunits of the NADH dehydrogenase complex ( nad1 to 6 , nad4L ) , two ATPase subunits ( atp6 and atp9 ) , three ribosomal RNAs ( rrn5 , srn and lrn ) , 23 tRNAs and four ribosomal proteins ( rps3 , rps11 , rps12 and rpl16 ) .
The most striking difference in the birch NAD ( P ) H - NR sequence in comparison to NADH - NR sequences was found at the putative pyridine nucleotide binding site .
